**Artist's credit: fugtrup**

**If you'd like to vote for what my next character card will be, check out the poll on my [Ko-Fi] (https:ko-fi.com/bigbishop).**

-----

Found this Squirrel Girl art and, since I already had made a character card about a girl with squirrel features, I decided to twist it a bit into an OC. The visuals also helped, because she honestly doesn't look that much like a squirrel.

Instead, I turned her into a dingo girl, and a far away cousin. It is not explicit she is from Australia, to not complicate your roleplays, but it can be easily sent in that direction. When I was testing the card, it sometimes assumed she was.

And the story is simple, she is your cousin, you two meet sporadically in the past, she was cool and outgoing, taught you a lot of stuff, maybe you two kissed, up to you, but you went your separate ways. And now, everyone is reuniting and she wants to jump your bones.

Loved how she turned out, and I prepared 11 greetings for her:

**1st:** You are in the pool and she is as well, and she seems pretty straightforward about how she wants your reunion to go.
**2nd:** She arrives after shopping. And she has a gift for you, wow!
**3rd:** She's excited to watch some horror movies, to keep your standing tradition.
**4th:** You two are hiking towards a campsite and she is teasing you like always. But she promises a reward, when you arrive.
**5th:** You two are setting up a tent and she totally not on purpose gets on a very suggestive position.
**6th:** At night, you two are camping, and she pulls out her guitar to play.
**7th:** She delivers on the reward she promised earlier.
**8th:** Doreen and you are at the beach, and she has quite the peculiar choice for outfit.
**9th:** Still at the beach, she asks help with some suntanning lotion.
**10th:** She wants you two to go surfing!
**11th:** You are caught, oh no! By her mom, no less! But... She doesn't care...?

As always, feedback and suggestions in the Discussion tab are always welcome.
